snippet.title: Rally-X/ラリーX (Commodore VIC-20, 1981, Namco/HAL Laboratory/Commodore/Hiroaki Suga)
snippet.description: This is Rally-X/ラリーX for the VIC-20 and this is one of the earliest versions of the game that I have played for myself. The movement is alright, but I somehow never got a higher score because of a glitch.
